 UConn women’s basketball faces Texas tonight in Hartford on WFSB 
 Huskies return to Hartford for preseason action 
 By Rob Polansky Published : Oct. 19, 2026 at 12:58 PM EDT | Updated : 30 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google HARTFORD, Conn. (WFSB) - UConn women’s basketball returns to the PeoplesBank Arena in Hartford on Monday night.
 The Huskies host Texas as part of their preseason slate. Tip off is 7 p.m.
 Fans can watch the broadcast on WFSB.
 UConn was No. 2 in ESPN’s preseason top 25 while Texas ranked No. 9.
 UConn took down Syracuse 88-60 in its first preseason game a week ago.
 Seven Huskies put up double figures, including Sarah Strong with 15.
